title: Northbeam TechWorks Crew Certification, Crew Size and Site Readiness
content:
A crew attends a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job only in the shape the service requires. Five requirements are carried per TechWorks service: the certification the technician must hold for the work, whether two people must attend, what must be ready before the crew arrives, whether new electrical work is part of the service, and whether water or waste connections are part of it.

| TechWorks service | Certification the technician must hold | Two people must attend | What must be ready before the crew arrives | New electrical work part of the service | Water or waste connections part of the service |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | bench electronics certification | no | the item and its accessories brought to the counter | no | no |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | home installation certification | no | the space cleared and mains power within reach | no | no |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | audio and video calibration certification | no | the room cleared, seating in place and mains power within reach | no | no |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | appliance installation certification with local trade licence | yes | water, waste and mains connections accessible and the old item emptied | no | yes |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | enterprise deployment certification | yes | the dock booked, the rack space cleared and network drops live | no | no |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | enterprise deployment certification | no | the rack space cleared and network drops live | no | no |

### Notes on the requirements

- Two TechWorks services require two people to attend: the appliance service and the business deployment service. The other four are attended by one.
- New electrical work is part of no TechWorks service. Water or waste connections are part of one only, the appliance service.
- The business deployment service and the annual care service share one certification, the enterprise deployment certification. The appliance service is the one service asking for a local trade licence alongside its certification.
